contract_reconciliations.reason: The validator confirmed the signed benchmark-cookie behavior, not a violation of the intended accounting contract. The invoking constraint explicitly requires purpose to derive from the signed role and missing benchmark admission to fail closed. lib/live/projects.test.ts:82-85 asserts that refusal; lib/live/hosted-access.ts:55-58 preserves signed identity and supplies public access when no valid cookie exists. Silent public fallback would misclassify internal tests. The operator can clear placy_demo_access for the shared host or use a fresh browser session to exercise anonymous public access; docs/research/voice-infrastructure/operations.md:44 already specifies health checks without a cookie. No authorization change is requested. Any more explicit cookie-reset guidance belongs to the planned U6 operations update, not a P2 access defect.
